summary: the recovery system's SSH key on an installed disk, the rkey and nokey assertions of the case machine.installer.install on i686, through tests/run installer on the tree's recovery init and installer

argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 utils krffs ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/images/cases/recovery.iso build/images/cases/recovery.krffs build/images/cases/recovery-keyless.krffs build/images/cases/install-stick.img build/images/rach2-recovery*.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery*.iso build/images/installer-test.disk build/images/install-test-stick.img build/utils/sbin/init-recovery && make -s utils ARCH=i686 </dev/null && make -s -j8 build/images/install-test-stick.img build/images/installer-test.disk build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/utils/sbin/init-recovery ${WORK}/init-recovery && rm -f ${WORK}/rach2-install && build/krffs/readfile.krffs build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.krffs /bin/rach2-install ${WORK}/rach2-install
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run installer 'run: installer: PASS'

faults.name: init-mutated
faults.summary: the recovery init does not read the disk's key, since it asks the boot line for a slot no boot names

faults.name: installer-mutated
faults.summary: the installer does not copy the key it was given to the recovery partition

faults.name: server-always
faults.summary: the recovery init starts its SSH server with no key to let in

faults.name: server-late
faults.summary: the recovery init starts its SSH server one turn of its loop late, after its first test for a key
